newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds weaker, off lows amid rate fears.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds weaker, off lows amid rate fears.

text.p: Portuguese cash bonds and futures recovered slightly from the opening lows amid fears over possible U.S. and German rate rises ahead, dealers said.
"The Portuguese market is recovering from the opening levels and is stronger than other European markets, due to buying by institutional investors," a dealer said.
Dealers said the possibility of a rise of German rates, due to the weakness of the mark against the dollar, was weighing on the mood across European markets.
